tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i gzhi bdag khyad par can klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen 'khor dang bcas pa la springs pa bzhugs so// swasti/ dpal sa skya'i gzhi bdag khyad par can klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bye brag rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bka' dam rjes su dgongs la dpal sa skya'i chos srid mi nor rdzas gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang / khyad par gdung rabs rin chen phreng bar gnod par byed pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon rbod gtong sogs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dpal sa skya'i lugs gnyis dpal 'byor phun tshogs thams cad dang / bye brag 'khon gyi gdung brgyud sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul lo zla ma 'gyangs par myur du byon nas zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad phrin bzhed dgongs thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dpal sa skya pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i mnga' 'bangs su khams gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dang / bye brag bod kyi mkhas btsun bzang gsum che dgu gnyen dgu kha drag stobs 'byor gyis dregs pa ci mchis rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas/ 'khon gdung rim pa can rnams kyi zhabs pad gtsug gis mchod cing ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang pho brang bzhi thog sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo/ ngo mtshar rten bzhis thog drangs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang / chos grwa lho byang gis thog drangs dge 'dun gyi sde ci mchis/ sde dge sa skyong rnams kyi thog drangs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gang yod/ cha zhabs khams drung gi thog drangs mnga' 'bangs yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las bsrung zhing dge legs thams cad spel ba dang /

bsam don thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grub pa'i dpung grogs bla med par 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ snyigs dus bstan la gnod byed spyi dang bye brag dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa la log par lta zhing sku tshe mdzad 'phrin la bar du gcod pa dang dgon gnas longs spyod 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi la na tsha/ phyugs la god kha/ lo dgra/ tshong dang 'bul ba'i kha 'gegs/ legs byas nyes par lta ba dpal 'byor la phrag dog bsam ngan 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs phyi nang gsang gsum gang na gnas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam la thal ba'i rdul du rlog la phyin chad gnod byed rnams kyi ming tsam yang mi grags par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi dgongs bzhed dang bdag cag 'khon rigs brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bsam pa dang rjes 'brangs mkhas grub dad can bu slob sbyin bdag bcas kyis 'dod don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub nas dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las dang bcas pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzad du gsol// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal sa skya'i gzhi bdag klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen 'khor bcas la springs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
